text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis: \"driverless vehicles are unfortunately just not practical\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps that position easy to follow throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on warning systems, traffic laws, and liability","quality":"argument organization","description":"It develops the claim in separate, focused points instead of moving through ideas in a more list-like way."},{"evidence":"quotes from GM, Google, BMW, and the law section","quality":"textual support","description":"It uses multiple specific details from the source article to back up its reasons."},{"evidence":"rhetorical questions about buying a \"driverless\" car and crash fault","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"It goes beyond stating disadvantages by explaining why those disadvantages make the cars impractical."},{"evidence":"\"why would a consumer buy\" and \"the whole issue is messy\"","quality":"persuasive tone","description":"It writes with a more forceful, argumentative voice that pushes the reader toward agreement."}]}
